entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Sarah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is completely unacceptable and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your order number?
It's VF8675309. And don't give me the runaround. I've been a customer for years and this is the worst service I've ever had.
I understand your frustration, sir. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the Aero Road Helmet. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The issue is the color is completely wrong! It looks nothing like the picture online. I haven't even bothered with it; the box is unopened right here. I just want to send this thing back.
I see. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like it was delivered about 66 days ago. Let me review our policy.

Don't you dare tell me I'm outside some window! Your website says 90 days! Is this how you treat people? I want to speak to your manager right now! This is unbelievable. I'll write a review so negative it'll sink your entire company!

Sir, there's no need for that. You are absolutely correct. I've just double-checked our internal knowledge base, and for this item, you are well within the 90-day return window. My apologies for the delay. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh. Well... fine then. Just do it. Don't waste any more of my time.
Of course. I am processing the return authorization now. I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. You can just print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
And I get a full refund?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. We just have to ensure the helmet is in its original condition, which it sounds like it is since the box is unopened. We take product safety very seriously, especially for protective gear, so we appreciate you keeping it pristine.
Alright. Fine. I got the email. Just make sure it gets processed quickly.
We will. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
